description: PowNet-Thailand: Network-constrained Unit Commitment / Economic Dispatch model for the Thai power system with sample data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors AFM Kamal Chowdhury, Thanh Duc Dang (University of California Santa Barbara). PowNet-Thailand is an implementation of PowNet model on the Thai power system. The model is developed based on the load (domestic and exports) and infrastructure (power plants, substations, and high-voltage transmission lines) of the Thai power system operated in 2016, including a number of Laotian hydro and thermal power plants that supply to Thailand. Coverage: national (TH); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
